question.worked_solution:
For compatible matrices $A,$ $B,$ and $C,$ and scalar $\alpha ,$ the Hadamard product has the following properties:

- Commutativity:

$$
A⊙B=B⊙A
$$

- Associativity:

$$
(A⊙B)⊙C=A⊙(B⊙C)
$$

- Distributivity over Addition:

$$
A⊙(B+C)=A⊙B+A⊙C
$$

- Scalar Distributivity:

$$
\alpha (A⊙B)=(\alpha A)⊙B=A⊙(\alpha B)
$$

In this case, by the associativity and distributivity over addition of the Hadamard product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}A⊙(B+C)+A⊙(B⊙C) & =A⊙B+A⊙C+(A⊙B)⊙C \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-4 & 2 \\ 3 & -1\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ -2 & 4\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-4 & 2 \\ 3 & -1\end{aligned}]⊙[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ 2 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}4 & 6 \\ 6 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1+4 & 2+6 \\ 1+6 & 3+2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 8 \\ 7 & 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
